summary.narrow: Sacred highland peak and former FALINTIL stronghold: a demanding trek combining mountain landscape, pilgrimage symbolism and resistance history.

sections.content: Sacred highland peak and former FALINTIL stronghold: a demanding trek combining mountain landscape, pilgrimage symbolism and resistance history.

entry.hours: No gate timetable published by the official tourism portal; treat as a daylight/guided mountain route rather than a museum-style attraction.
entry.ticket: No standardized public ticket confirmed; guide/transport/community costs are arranged locally.
entry.closure_notes: Pilgrimage events, rain, road damage, cloud and local customary restrictions can change access.
entry.notes: Reach the Baucau/Quelicai side by road; the official tourism portal describes Matebian as a challenging climb and part of Timor-Leste's guided highland trekking offer. Confirm the local trailhead and road condition with a Timorese guide/operator before departure.

rules.permit_or_guide: Local guide strongly recommended because the mountain is sacred, routes are not a standardized park trail system, and the area carries resistance/pilgrimage history.

seasonality.best_period: Dry season is the practical planning preference for mountain roads/trails; confirm locally before the climb.
seasonality.heat_rain_notes: High elevation is cooler and windier than the coast; cloud, rain and low visibility can develop quickly.
seasonality.site_specific_notes: Seasonality guidance is field-planning inference from elevation and Timor-Leste's wet/dry pattern; route status must be confirmed locally.

visual_recon.drone: Do not assume permission on a sacred mountain; obtain aviation/local/community approval before launch.
visual_recon.filming_restrictions: Ask before filming ceremonies, pilgrims, sacred features or community members.
